'''"Rudy"''' was the name of the customized [[RDD-7 racing swoop]] owned by [[Grubber Vapps]], a [[Constable/Legends|Second]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]], [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. An amateur [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], Vapps spent most of his free time performing modifications on "Rudy," including a reinforced frame and a bow-mounted weapon. Although Vapps had modified several vehicles, he was particularly proud of "Rudy."

Around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], some outlaws stole "Rudy" and Vapps and some friends of his did their best to recover the vehicle.
